title: Agent Kill Chain Stage Detector: Automated ATT&CK-Style Stage Classification

original_idea.body:
# Agent Kill Chain Stage Detector: Automated ATT&CK-Style Stage Classification

**Problem:** The LessWrong 2026 ATT&CK-style threat matrix exists conceptually, but no tool exists to automatically classify observed agent behaviors into kill chain stages.

**Direction:** Implement a text classifier trained on synthetic examples of agent actions labeled by kill chain stage (reconnaissance, lateral movement, privilege escalation, exfiltration, etc.). Evaluate on agent logs from controlled experiments. Compute classification accuracy per stage.

**Why it matters:** Real-time kill chain stage classification would enable SIEM-like alerting for agentic deployments, triggering automated responses when an agent progresses through dangerous stages.

**Relevant context:** LessWrong 2026 ATT&CK matrix; MITRE ATT&CK; agent log analysis; text classification.
